title: KEVIN BLOODY WILSON
tickerText: ** YOU GOTTA GO SEE KEVIN LIVE **    KEVIN BLOODY WILSON IS AN AUSTRALIAN COMEDY ICON, SINGER, SONGWRITER AND STORYTELLER WHO HAS SPENT DECADES TURNING EVERYDAY LIFE, OUTRAGEOUS CHARACTERS AND THE AUSTRALIAN SENSE OF HUMOUR INTO UNFORGETTABLE SONGS. ARMED WITH A GUITAR, A FEARLESS ATTITUDE AND A LANGUAGE ALL HIS OWN, KEV HAS BUILT A LOYAL FOLLOWING ACROSS AUSTRALIA, NEW ZEALAND, THE UNITED KINGDOM AND BEYOND. HIS LIVE SHOWS ARE LOUD, CHEEKY, UNFILTERED AND PACKED WITH THE KIND OF LAUGHTER THAT LEAVES AN AUDIENCE QUOTING LINES ALL THE WAY HOME. FROM CULT CLASSICS TO FAN FAVOURITES, HIS SONGS CELEBRATE THE CHARACTERS, CONTRADICTIONS AND LARRIKIN SPIRIT OF AUSTRALIAN LIFE. THIS VIDEO JUKEBOX BRINGS TOGETHER A SELECTION OF KEVIN'S MOST MEMORABLE PERFORMANCES, CLIPS AND COMEDY MOMENTS. BROWSE THE COLLECTION, CHOOSE A FAVOURITE, TURN IT UP AND ENJOY ONE OF AUSTRALIA'S MOST DISTINCTIVE ENTERTAINERS DOING WHAT HE DOES BEST: SAYING THE THINGS OTHER PEOPLE WOULD NEVER DARE TO SAY, WITH A GRIN, A GUITAR AND ABSOLUTELY NO APOLOGIES!!
